turn.content: The ledger confirms the full picture. There is only one goods receipt (GR-2026-0134, 10 labels + 5 bubble wrap), which fully matches the PO. The earlier invoice INV-SPL-00190 already billed the entire PO amount of 2,555,220 on 2026-09-28. This invoice bills the identical lines and the identical total. Total invoiced across both invoices = 20 labels + 10 bubble wrap, far exceeding the 10 + 5 received. No second receipt exists to support a "separate delivery."
